experiment: N12TWO: N=12 L=1 two-template bimodal cluster-mean transfer, frozen v4 center-4 Nov3 vs QAOA p=1
closed_axes: Stop more two-template copies at new untested sizes. Stop more unsigned-mean copies at other N (FT PR120 ladder N9/N12/N15/N18). Stop more L3 start-count/freeze-order/shell-unshare/two-stage/tied-SNAP. Stop more center-4 L2/depth copies. hypothesis.one_sentence: At N=12 L=1, energy-min of two train cluster-mean Nov3 templates (partition by sign(s1)) minus energy-min of two train cluster-mean QAOA templates (partition by sign(beta)) has mean ΔE CI entirely <0 on 8 unread test instances.
hypothesis.not: Independent-stream confirmation of FT PR124. Does not copy FT PR124 N=12 numbers or reuse 10776-91. Not L2/L3. Not a GR patch. Not an adoption. Not a new gate from PR116/PR119/PR121/PR123/PR125 test sets. Does not replace per-instance SPSA. Transfer-gap CI entirely >0 is descriptive only and does not switch the primary. Unsigned mean and s1-only sign-align are secondary replication descriptives only.

split_documented_before_fits.rule: Stage A fits train only. Freeze both Nov3 cluster means (sign(s1)), both QAOA cluster means (sign(beta)), unsigned means, and s1-sign-aligned Nov3 mean from train before any test SPSA or transfer energy. Empty clusters are recorded and do not invent a template. Two-template energy = min of that method's frozen nonempty cluster-template energies (energy-only; not F; not test-time SPSA). Primary vs secondary not chosen on test.

nov3_clusters.empty: record and do not invent a template

qaoa_clusters.empty: record and do not invent a template

transfer_eval.empty_cluster_rule: skip that template; do not invent; two-template reduces to the nonempty cluster mean
transfer_eval.two_template_energy: min of that method's charged nonempty cluster-template energies; no extra query
transfer_eval.charge: every energy call; no query-free prefix
